summary: Added a requirement for account lockout after failed login attempts based on domain knowledge. Enhanced the 'Forgot Password' acceptance criterion to include token expiry and invalidation behavior.

additions.description: The system must lock a user account temporarily after five consecutive failed login attempts.
additions.rationale: This prevents brute-force attacks and protects user accounts from unauthorized access.

modifications.original_description: When the user clicks the 'Forgot Password' link, they must be directed to the password recovery initiation page.
modifications.enhanced_description: When the user clicks the 'Forgot Password' link, they must be directed to the password recovery initiation page, where a time-limited reset token (valid for 30-60 minutes) is generated and sent to the user's verified email address.
modifications.rationale: This ensures secure and controlled password recovery by incorporating token expiry and verification practices from domain standards.
